newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said there would be a briefing on the telecoms negotiations taking place in Geneva in spokesman Peter Guilford's office on Tuesday at 1415/1315 GMT.

In answer to a question spokesman Patrick Child said the Commission's economic review for 1996 would be released on Thursday. He said the text still had to be finalized. Child also said it would not contain new figures but would be based on the ones released by the Commission in November, 1996.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/103: Single market action plan - Commission organises conference and Internet Forum.
- IP/97/104: Commission authorizes the acquisition of the Italian Unione Italiana di Riassicuriazione S.P.A. by Schweizerische Rueckversicherungs-gesellschaft.
- Memo/97/15: Euro-Mediterranean partnership: implementation of the multilateral aspects of the Barcelona Declaration.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Energy and industry No 1997-1: Extracts from "Monthly panorama of European industry 1/97".
- Assembly of the European Regions press release: AER's political programme for 1997.
- Business and consumer surveys - first results: January 1997 - No1.
